capabilities: Show today's canteen menu in the sidebar with dishes, prices and dietary badges
Search and add canteens by name, city or URL across Seezeit, Studierendenwerk Erlangen-Nürnberg and OpenMensa
Pick a different day to view upcoming menus, skipping days without data
Configure which price tier (Students, Staff, Guests) is shown and reorder saved canteens
Open the menu from a shortcut link (obsidian://canteen) with a specific canteen preselected
extras: Extensive privacy section explaining which hosts are contacted and that menus are cached locally; strong disclaimer that allergen data may be wrong and must not be relied on for health decisions; unsupported locations work by pasting a feed URL; status bar of a menu photo is not displayed — menus load weekly, cached locally with a manual refresh and a fallback to the last saved menu.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view a canteen's daily menu, so users must leave the app or check a website to see what's being served.

relations.evidence: OpenMensa: community directory with canteens all over Germany.
Seezeit Studierendenwerk Bodensee: HTWG Konstanz, Gießberg (University of Konstanz), Fallenbrunnen (Friedrichshafen), Weingarten, Ravensburg.
Studierendenwerk Erlangen-Nürnberg: Mensa Süd and Langemarckplatz (Erlangen), Insel Schütt and Regensburger Straße (Nürnberg), Ansbach, Eichstätt, Ingolstadt.

summary: Sidebar panel that shows today's menu from German university canteens (Seezeit, Studierendenwerk Erlangen-Nürnberg, OpenMensa) with prices and allergens.
